text:
maria: p95 jumped from ~180ms to 2.3s around 09:14 UTC. Hosted cluster 3-az-east shows queue depth spikes. Anyone watching?
infra-bot: ALERT: hosted-api-prod p95 latency > 2s (09:14:21). pods=redwood-runtime-3x, region=us-east. links: https://grafana/redwood/d/hosted/latency
raj: looking. initial thought: kernel-selector churn after yesterday's model rollout? saw affinity flips in selector logs.
sasha: attaching quick profile dump from 09:13-09:16 (short). main surprise is a lot of time in `aux_kernel_dispatch` and `kv_cache_miss_handler` rather than attention kernels.
raj: that's consistent with kernel selector preferring aux kernels for short sequences, but why so many KV misses?
yuki: KV miss rate spiked from 6% -> 78% at the same time. I see a priming wave from a single tenant (#acct-9745) sending lots of short-seq requests. logs: `kv_cache: tenant=acct-9745 miss=0.78 window=30s`
sasha: paste of flame snippet:
```
# flame (trimmed)
aux_kernel_dispatch 45%
kv_cache_miss_handler 18%
batching_coalesce 12%
attention_forward 8%
other 17%
```
raj: hm. if priming requests are short, selector switches kernel affinity to aux kernels; that fragments batching (lots of tiny batches) and increases kernel switch overhead. plus kv misses make each request pay mem-copy overhead.
maria: could noisy tenant be causing batch fragmentation + kernel rebind churn? that would explain p95 and throughput drop.
yuki: confirmed: tenant acct-9745 spike correlates with 09:12:30 -> 09:15:10; bursty load of 1-3 token prompts at 200rps.
raj: mitigation options: 1) throttle that tenant via rate engine, 2) force kernel_pin for host-level routes to avoid selector oscillation, 3) widen coalesce window temporarily to rebuild batching. Thoughts?
sasha: quick perf test: widening coalesce by +10ms reduced overhead in staging for mixed short/long by ~25%. kernel_pin avoids selector cost but could hurt long-seq hot paths.
maria: Ops, can we throttle acct-9745 to 50rps for now? @ops-bot?
ops-bot: runbook: `./infractl throttle tenant acct-9745 --rps 50 --duration 15m` queued (requires approval).
raj: I'll open a quick config patch to set `coalesce_ms` +10 and add a temporary kernel_pin for hosted-default route. rolling patch to 10% of runtime nodes first.
yuki: also pushing a monitoring alert for kv_cache_miss_rate > 0.5 and kernel_selector_flip_rate > 0.2/min so we catch recurrence.
infra-bot: deploy started: rollout redwood-runtime config v2.3.1-coalesce-pin canary -> 10% at 09:23:12
sasha: profiling canary nodes after change shows aux_kernel_dispatch drop from 45% -> 22%, coalesce waits slightly higher but end-to-end p95 improved in canary.
ops-bot: throttle approved and applied to acct-9745 at 09:24:05.
maria: after throttle + canary config, p95 dropped to ~210ms at 09:26 UTC. good sign.
raj: action items: - (raj) push coalesce+pin to 100% after 30m if stable - (yuki) create alert + kcache dashboards - (sasha) write repro script to simulate short-seq priming wave - (maria) follow up with infra-sre about tenant contract (noisy neighbor mitigation).
maria: thanks all. I'll leave the thread open for 1h then close and create a postmortem if this repeats. :raised_hands:
infra-bot: note: rollback available: `infractl rollback redwood-runtime v2.3.0`
raj: will watch for oscillation after full rollout. ping me if p95 creeps back above 400ms.
yuki: logs/trace link: https://traces.redwood/trace/4898765432-surge - saves the span IDs for later.
maria: closing in 45m unless new alerts. great triage, team. :thumbsup:
